newsitem.title: USA: Emerson Electric says hopes for good FY97.
newsitem.headline: Emerson Electric says hopes for good FY97.

text.p: Emerson Electric Co is "cautiously optimistic" the fiscal year ending next September will be a good one despite forecasts of slowing worldwide economic growth, chairman and chief executive officer Charles Knight said Tuesday.

Emerson's consolidated sales increase by more than 11 percent to $11.1 billion for the year ended September 30 reflects strong international demand, moderate domestic growth and business combinations, he said in a year-end statement.
International sales, including exports, grew 11 percent and accounted for 44 percent of total sales, he said.
